user.title: AWS Bedrock
user.description: Choose the AWS region and enter credentials of an IAM user allowed to query Amazon Bedrock metadata there. The next step lists active streaming text model and system inference-profile metadata for that region. Listing does not verify model access or invocation permission.

data_description.aws_session_token: Leave empty for long-lived IAM user keys. Temporary credentials expire, and Home Assistant will then ask for new ones.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Discovered models and inference profiles in {region}: {count}. Entries with a geographic prefix (us., eu., apac., global.) are inference profiles, which newer models require. Bedrock checks model access and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream permission when the agent invokes the selected model or profile. The model must support tool use for device control.

data_description.llm_hass_api: "Device control" is Home Assistant's built-in Assist API and is recommended. "AWS Bedrock Services" is this integration's own API from version 1.x.

reauth_confirm.title: AWS credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: AWS rejected the stored credentials for {region}. Enter new ones.

data_description.aws_session_token: Leave empty for long-lived IAM user keys. Temporary credentials expire, and Home Assistant will then ask for new ones.

reconfigure.title: Change region or credentials
reconfigure.description: Change the region or credentials. If the region changes, the next step lists model and inference-profile metadata for the new region; otherwise each agent keeps its model.

data_description.aws_session_token: Leave empty for long-lived IAM user keys. Temporary credentials expire, and Home Assistant will then ask for new ones.

reconfigure_model.title: Choose a model
reconfigure_model.description: Discovered models and inference profiles in {region}: {count}. The selected model is set for every agent of this integration; each agent can be changed afterwards.

error.invalid_auth: AWS rejected these credentials. Check the access key, secret and session token.
error.access_denied: AWS accepted these credentials, but model metadata could not be listed. Grant bedrock:ListFoundationModels and bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles. Model invocation is checked later and requires bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach AWS. Check the network connection.
error.no_models: No models could be listed for this region. You can still type a model or inference profile ID.

abort.already_configured: These credentials are already set up for this region.

timeout.message: AWS Bedrock took too long to answer.

auth_error.message: AWS rejected the credentials. Update them in the integration settings.

access_denied.message: Access to this Bedrock model was denied ({code}). Check model access and IAM permissions.

response_blocked.message: The answer was blocked by a content filter.

context_window_exceeded.message: The conversation is too long for this model. Start a new conversation.

too_many_tool_calls.message: I could not complete that request.

too_many_tool_calls_in_response.message: The model sent too many tool requests in one response (maximum {maximum}). No tools were run.

tool_args_error.message: The model sent an invalid tool request.

system_message_not_found.message: The conversation has no system prompt.

response_too_long.message: The answer was cut off by the token limit. Use Reconfigure agent to increase "Maximum tokens in a response".

set_options.title: Agent settings
set_options.description: Region: {region}. Models and inference profiles discovered: {count}. Use Reconfigure on the integration to change the region or credentials.

data.confirm_sensitive_actions: Ask for spoken confirmation before unlocking, opening doors, garages or gates, running scripts and other sensitive actions
data.name: Name

data_description.prompt: Instructions for the assistant. Home Assistant adds the current date and, with device control enabled, the exposed devices. Templates are supported.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Choose one or both exposure-bounded APIs. Both respect Settings → Voice assistants → Expose. The unrestricted admin Home Assistant API and arbitrary third-party APIs are deliberately not offered.
data_description.prompt_caching: Reuses the instructions and tool list between requests, which lowers cost and latency on models that support it. Turned off automatically for models that do not.
data_description.confirm_sensitive_actions: The assistant asks a fixed question naming the action; only a clear yes from the same person and device runs it.

error.no_models: No models could be listed for this region. You can still type a model or inference profile ID.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Check the credentials first.
